entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 研究提出了一种冠醚功能化的Spiro衍生物作为多功能界面层。分子设计优化了钙钛矿表面的能级排列，通过π-π堆积增强分子堆积，并实现双Li+/Pb2+螯合以抑制离子迁移和缺陷复合。该协同方法使电池实现了26.06%的光电转换效率及出色的运行稳定性。
kp: 光电转换效率[冠醚功能化Spiro衍生物界面修饰钙钛矿电池]: 26.06%
界面层材料[钙钛矿表面p型修饰]: 冠醚功能化的Spiro衍生物
缺陷抑制机理[协同钝化]: 双重Li+/Pb2+螯合抑制离子迁移和缺陷复合
entries.b: This study introduces a crown-ether-functionalized Spiro derivative (Spiro-AC) as a multifunctional interfacial layer. Rational molecular design enables perovskite surface p-type modification for optimized energy-level alignment, enhanced molecular packing via π-π stacking, and dual Li+/Pb2+ chelation suppressing ion migration and defect recombination. This synergistic approach yields champion devices achieving 26.06% efficiency with exceptional operational stability.
